0.msg:
Hi there, uh... warrior? 
Because I'm so great, I've been elected the new #espokesperson for Monsterkind!#n My name is #bClara#k, but I'm nothing like that OTHER Clara. 
Anyway... How much do you know about the #eeveryday lives of monsters#n? In celebration of the 11th Anniversary, we've prepared an opportunity for the warriors of Maple World to put a face to the hard-working monsters they heartlessly terrorize. 
Oh! And we're giving out amazing gifts!

1.msg:
Taking advantage of this amazing opportunity is easy! 
First, speak to the wonderful #bClara#n#k.Next, experience our varied and interesting arrangement of #eMonster Tales#n!Finally, receive your gift!
It's so simple any stab-happy Mapler could do it.
You can start making up for a long life of monster-murder all while earning shiny gifts!

2.msg: So... you don't want me to defeat any monsters? I just sit and watch, and then I get a gift...? This all seems a little fishy.

3.msg:
Hurt monsters? How dare you? The whole point is to rethink your abuses against monsterkind! 
Oh, and one more thing. Episodes of Monster Tales will focus on just #bone monster per day#k.
Three new stories are released every weekend, one a day. When all is said and done, you'll have the chance to observe the noble lives of #etwelve monsters#n in total. #eIf you participate on the day of the premier,#n you will be gifted with #eTHREE TIMES the amount of gifts#n!#n

no.0: But I prepared a bunch of awesome gifts! What's wrong? Is it my name?
